question: Should current main restore the `v2026.6.11` Claude live-session prepared-cleanup ownership transfer now, or should this remain blocked on a fresh live reproduction against current main?
rationale: The source path strongly supports the reporter's symptom, but the issue already carries `clawsweeper:no-new-fix-pr`, `clawsweeper:needs-maintainer-review`, and `clawsweeper:needs-live-repro`, and the latest release contains a fix shape that current main lacks.

options.title: Restore the released cleanup-transfer shape

options.title: Confirm current main is intentional
